$comment: Drill-through DataGrid configuration template. Use for grids embedded in a Custom Page or workspace surface that is scoped to a parent record (e.g. Matter Health -> KPI Assessments). The host shell must mount <DataGrid configId=... parentContext={{ <parent-context-key>: '<parent-record-id>' }} />. REPLACE <entity-name>, <savedquery-id>, <parent-attribute>, <parent-context-key>, and column keys. See docs/guides/DATAGRID-FRAMEWORK-CONFIGURATION-GUIDE.md.

secondaryActions.$comment: Row-hover navigate action example. Kind 'navigate' opens the target record. Delete or edit this block if not applicable.
secondaryActions.label: Open parent record

parentContextFilter.$comment: Injects a top-level FetchXML condition at render time when parentContext[<parent-context-key>] is set on the host. Attribute is the CHILD entity's lookup back to the parent (e.g. sprk_matter). Default operator is 'eq'.
